purpose: Reconcile the retained 96-object private role and GNU-property fact plane against authenticated GNU readelf -h/-l/-d/-n evidence without making readelf runtime authority.

status.reason: readelf exit status is not the x64lens parser contract

property_contributor_count.reason: readelf does not retain original PHDR contributor multiplicity

property_unknown_count.reason: readelf textual unknown-property and unknown-bit categories are not isomorphic to the private count

property_overlap_count.reason: readelf output does not expose x64lens carrier-overlap accounting

eligibility_rules.role_fields: eligible when readelf header/program-header/dynamic output is parseable
eligibility_rules.property_fields: eligible only when the retained x64lens object status is success and readelf emits no corrupt, truncated, or warning marker for the property view
eligibility_rules.ambiguous_and_unavailable: retained explicitly and excluded from mismatch acceptance
